content.text: No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalty mechanic exists anywhere in the document. I'll submit a compliant finding.

input.quote: Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services provided through the effective termination date, and Vendor shall promptly refund prepaid Fees allocable to the period after that date.
input.rationale: We searched the Agreement for liquidated damages, penalties, early-termination or cancellation charges, minimum fees on termination, and acceleration of Fees, and found none payable by Customer. On Customer's convenience termination (§ 9.4) Customer owes Fees only for conforming Services rendered to the termination date, with a refund of prepaid Fees; § 27.3 lets Customer terminate for prolonged force majeure "without penalty"; and § 7.3 bars interest on amounts found not due. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is warranted. Note for completeness: the § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum commitment is a volume commitment rather than a liquidated damages or penalty amount and is addressed under the minimum-commitment rule; we do not double-flag it here.

mappings.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
